issues.where: top edge, above the polar vortex (crops F, K)
issues.what: the globe's top limb and its glow run into the frame edge and get cut off, so the halo looks like a flat band along the border instead of a clean falloff
issues.fix: shrink the globe or move it down so the whole limb and atmosphere glow sit inside the frame with dark sky above

issues.where: sunlit left limb (crops B, D, K, P)
issues.what: the lit hemisphere blows out to a smooth cream with no cloud detail, plus a wide bloom, so the limb looks airbrushed and plastic
issues.fix: pull the highlights back, keep cloud texture right out to the limb, and make the atmosphere rim thinner and tighter

issues.where: sunlit left limb (crops B, D, K, O, T)
issues.what: same blown-out, airbrushed band along the lit limb, with no texture in the outer 10-15% of the disc
issues.fix: lower the exposure on the dayside limb and keep the cloud detail visible through the haze

issues.where: night side, right half (crops C, E, I, L, P, Q, U)
issues.what: the night side is just a darker, greyer copy of the day texture with full cloud relief and no real terminator gradient, so the light looks flat and the shading looks like a colour adjustment
issues.fix: move into real darkness past a soft terminator; only the twilight band should show raking-light relief

issues.where: dark right limb (crops C, E, H, R, V)
issues.what: a thin bright rim line runs along the unlit limb and reads as a doubled or outlined edge next to the dark disc
issues.fix: fade the rim with the light angle so it is strongest near the sun side and almost gone on the far night limb

issues.where: lower centre, night side (crop I, Q)
issues.what: the violet lightning squiggles are sharp and saturated and sit on top of the cloud instead of glowing through it, so they look stuck on
issues.fix: blur and scatter the flashes under the cloud tops, lower their saturation, and add a soft local glow

issues.where: mid-disc feathered bands (crops A, P, Q)
issues.what: the feather or brushstroke cloud texture repeats the same streak shape over and over and looks painted rather than fluid
issues.fix: break up the repeated streaks with more varied scales of turbulence

issues.where: planet edge against the Milky Way, right side (crops G, I, Q)
issues.what: a soft dark haze stands off the night limb, giving it a slight halo against the bright Milky Way
issues.fix: tighten the outer edge of the atmosphere on the night side so the disc meets the sky cleanly

issues.where: lower-right, bottom, and lower-left limb (native crops image-14.png D, H, I and image-15.png O, P, Q)
issues.what: doubled and tripled concentric rim bands separated by dark gaps wrap around the lower-right and unlit nightside limb as a detached halo, with pinpoint stars sitting directly on top of the limb band
issues.fix: replace the multi-ring limb shell with a single smooth atmospheric scattering falloff that fades out on the unlit nightside and occludes background stars behind the limb

issues.where: upper-left and middle-right globe surface (native crops image-14.png A, B, F, G and image-15.png K)
issues.what: two tight spiral vortices pinch and swirl on the visible face of the globe with stretched painterly brush-like cloud streaks and noisy stippled orange-brown patches
issues.fix: relax the pinched bullseye vortices into natural planetary cloud bands and render uniform fine-scale cloud-top detail instead of painterly streaks and stippled patches

issues.where: near-field foreground clouds along the bottom third (native crops image-10.png D, E, I and image-12.png T, V, W, X)
issues.what: near foreground clouds are soft, blurry, and smeared with diagonal airbrushed strokes at native size compared to the sharp middle-ground cumulus towers
issues.fix: preserve crisp turbulent cloud-top detail across the foreground layer so near surfaces hold up at native resolution without smeared airbrushed areas

issues.where: shadowed terminator and nightside cloud deck (native crops image-14.png D, H, I and image-15.png O, P)
issues.what: cloud texture across the dark lower-left hemisphere turns muddy, soft, and airbrushed where light falls off
issues.fix: maintain crisp cloud micro-structure into low-angle terminator lighting and let the nightside drop cleanly into dark shadow rather than smeared brushstrokes

issues.where: upper-right solar glare and horizon limb (native crops image-10.png C, G and image-11.png L, M, N)
issues.what: an artificial horizontal lens-flare bar cuts across the sky to the right border, creating a banded horizontal haze layer above the limb while sharp stars remain visible inside the bright solar glare
issues.fix: remove the horizontal flare streak, smooth the vertical atmospheric glow gradient above the limb, and wash out stars inside intense solar glare and dense horizon haze
